what: The best action breadth each live scenario has shown, and the published actions a farm fixture cannot reach.
howRead: tools/audit-action-breadth.mjs --result <bundle>; measured against the Mod's own registration table through tools/lib/stardew-published-action-registry.mjs
why: A count of executions cannot tell a varied day from 124 repetitions of three safe actions. `round39` reported
`executionTrace: { ok: true, rows: 124 }` and completed, having attempted 15 of the 95 published actions,
and nothing in its artifact said so. This file is the ratchet that makes the next such run visible: a run below

multiday_routine.label: round38
multiday_routine.measured: 24 distinct actions in 11 families over 379 executions, largest single action 22% (break_rock) - the widest multiday day on this machine out of the 172 multiday bundles that carry an attempted list

exclusions.reason: elevator-floor action: the floor set is not a client-supplied range, it is what `MineElevatorMenu` displays (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Models/BridgeProtocolModels.cs:483-497), so a fixture that has never descended a mine publishes no floor to select and the current floor is a native no-op

multiplayer-only: the one social act that is not about an NPC in front of the actor, sent to the whole lobby through `Multiplayer.sendChatMessage` (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Policy/FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:586-589); a native-local farm fixture has one farmhand and no peer to reach

needs a Raft in a tool slot (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Policy/FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:285, `ToolResource("raft", ...)`) and open water beside it; the native-local fixture's player starts with no raft and no farm day places one

targets the Bus Stop ticket machine of the current location (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Protocol/BridgeProtocol.cs:2094-2096) and drives `BusStop.checkAction+answerDialogue` (FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:272-283); the bus is out of order until the Vault repair, which a fixture that starts a fresh farm has not done
